review:
A Mexican 20-liner with instant coin wins and two kinds of collect symbol.

The bonus is basically Minesweeper: pick mystery boxes to build your win while trying not to hit the bomb. Afterwards you can gamble the whole prize to double it, capped at 5,000x – but lose and it's all gone. There's a buy that starts with four Lucky Coins. Medium-low volatility, 5,000x max, 96.35% RTP.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
